$description: Logo tones: overrides of the semantic logo roles for a given surface. Values are DERIVED by the build (scripts/brand/build-tokens.mjs): each role listed under `syd.tone.minContrast` is lightened in OKLCH (hue and chroma kept) just enough to reach the ratio against the tone's surface. Explicit $value entries are used as-is.

on-dark.$description: Logo on the dark site surface (navbar, footer, dashboard header).
